Your holdings: SMH (-31.86%), SOXL (-84.3%), and SMCI (-45.78%) are all "SELL" status and deep in the red. Many of your leveraged ETFs are also showing massive losses. Remember, trading on margin amplifies these drops significantly.

Watch: Keep a close eye on continued momentum in chip names. Also, be prepared for rapid moves in your leveraged positions.

Bottom line: Your immediate focus should be on risk management and re-evaluating ineffective stop-loss levels.
plays: Review Stops: Immediately check and adjust the stop-loss levels for SOXL, SMH, and SMCI; their current stops are far from current prices and ineffective.
Trim CRWD: Consider trimming some CRWD (+22.31%) to lock in profits and reduce overall portfolio risk.
New Buy NVDD: If adding chip exposure, NVDD (Nvidia Bull 2X) is on the scanner (entry 37.85-37.56, stop 36.87) and supported by recent Nvidia news.
